title: Teaching Kids Forth
excerpt: Forth is uncommonly used to teach programming to kids. Scripting languages like Python and visual environments like Scratch are far more popular options. But when I got the opportunity to introduce middle and high school students to programming, I chose the stack-oriented concatenative language from 1970. I was ecstatic about this opportunity. I'm passionate about giving people just a bit more control over the potential locked up in the devices they carry with them every day. When people know more about computers in general and about making their own software in particular, whole worlds open up. This gave me the chance to pry the door to that world open for people who likely would have never discovered it otherwise.
content_html:
2026-04-14 · 11 min · #computing

Forth is uncommonly used to teach programming to kids. Scripting languages like Python and visual environments like Scratch are far more popular options. But when I got the opportunity to introduce middle and high school students to programming, I chose the stack-oriented concatenative language from 1970.

I was ecstatic about this opportunity. I'm passionate about giving people just a bit more control over the potential locked up in the devices they carry with them every day. When people know more about computers in general and about making their own software in particular, whole worlds open up. This gave me the chance to pry the door to that world open for people who likely would have never discovered it otherwise.

While I had taught people programming to individuals previously, this was my first experience teaching in a classroom environment. I went from knowing next to nothing about teaching to designing my own curriculum, including lesson plans, curriculum, and a digital learning environment.

Why Forth?

I could have chose to teach any programming language. I could have chosen Python or Scratch, but I wanted to explore a path less commonly chosen and maybe find some gems that are otherwise overlooked.

Because of the limited amount of time I had to teach, and the fact that I wanted to teach more fundamental concepts, I wanted to avoid teaching syntax. While Python makes sense as pseudocode to someone who understands what code is, it is still nearly incomprehensible to new learners, which I discovered in previous years teaching programming one-on-one.

I decided I wanted to either teach Forth or Haskell. Forth was appealing because it's a concatenative language. You write the instructions and it simply executes everything in order. As long as you understand what a stack is you can write Forth programs.

Haskell was appealing because it integrates well with how students are already taught about how to think about variables and functions in mathematics. I've seen too many new programmers get confused that in programming variables are boxes that can contain any value instead of the algebraic definitions they've learned in math class.

I ended up choosing Forth for two reasons. First, it was easier to integrate into a custom learning environment I could prepare for the students. Second, I figured procedural programming would be easier to conceptualize than functional programming for the in-class final demo.

As a side benefit, the use of a semi-obscure language like Forth ensured that even students who did programming before would learn something from the experience without alienating new learners.

Designing the Cirriculum

When designing the cirriculum, I knew I would be pressed for time. I had 12 sessions, once per week, each one hour long. I also knew it wasn't likely they were going to complete much homework if I had assigned it considering they had lives outside of my class.

The tangible learning outcome was for students to create their own art in the Forth environment. This could be anything from a simple drawing to an animation to a game. I wanted them to have something they could see and keep with them after the course had ended. It can be discouraging to learn a lot of technical details on a topic and feel like you had little to show for it.

It was important that the students could run the code the wrote on their own computers. It was doubly important that they didn't have to download or install anything for it to work, since students could be using a variety of operating systems—some of which may not be capable of installing third party software.

My first choice for our learning environment involved writing my own Forth from scratch in Rust and embedding it in our course website with WASM. Unfortunately, ironing out the bugs in my implementation took longer than I intended. So I switched gears and chose to use Nick Morgan's Easy Forth as both our cirriculum and Forth interpreter.

For each lesson, I created slides and a lesson plan which I uploaded to an online portal which the students could access. This included a copy of Easy Forth.

Introducing Computing

It was then time to start going over the actual lessons with the students. I plugged my laptop into the large TV to display my slides and began the introductory lecture.

We started by going over the history of computing and what a computer is. One of my favorite parts was showing them various devices and asking them if they were computers. They were initially perplexed when I showed them an abacus and told them it was a computer. Our working definition was, "Anything that calculates numbers." They soon realized that almost anything could be a computer, including themselves!

This is a computer!

After breaking their idea of what a computer could be and setting their expectations, I began to teach them about Forth in particular. I explained the places it's used and its embedded applications.

Once the fundamentals were down, the next step was to move to our cirriculum and dive into Forth. However, Easy Forth assumes its readers know at least one programming language and know about stack-based data structures. That was far from the case here. It was my job to bridge that gap.

What is a Stack?

Before even touching our computers, we had to begin to visualize the fundamental data structure underlying Forth: the data stack.

Anyone with a rudimentary computer science education will understand what a data stack is and its operations, but normally that's not the first thing introduced to new learners.

So I used plates.

In Forth, when you type numbers surrounded by whitespace, they are added to the stack. For example, this adds 1, 2, and 3 to the data stack:

1 2 3

If you were to print these numbers, such as with . . ., the outputted text would be 3 2 1. This is because a stack is a Last-In First-Out data structure. You can either "push" an item onto a stack (put it on top), or pop an item off a stack (pull it off the top). For the most part, more complex operations are implemented in terms of those.

To represent this, I gave every student a pile of paper plates. I then instructed them to execute certain Forth operations with those plates. When instructed to push a number onto the stack, they wrote the number on a plate and put it on top of their stacks. When instructed to add the top two numbers on the stack, they removed them, added them, and pushed a new number onto the stack.

Push 7 and 6 to the top of the stack, then add the top two items of the stack and push the result on top. The result will be 13.

8 6 +

Push 2 and 3 to the top of the stack, then multiply the top two items of the stack, pushing the result on top. The result will be six.

2 3 *

I instructed them to perform many operations until they were familiar with what they were doing. They were acting as Forth interpreters. The computer is just doing this work automatically. This gave them a more intimate understanding of what their system was doing.

Only then did their machines do the work for them.

Moving Forth

With the stack fresh in their memories, we marched forward, following Easy Forth lessons week by week, keeping pace to complete them by the end of the course. It proceeded without issue. I explained the concepts, they did the exercises, and I answered questions as they came up.

Since we only had twelve hours together, the final project had to be small, but it also had to demonstrate the knowledge built up throughout the course. I determined that we would use the graphics framework created in Easy Forth to make our own art of any variety. It could be a picture, an animation, or a game. I didn't really believe they had time to make a game, but they were encouraged to tinker with the built-in snake game in order to make something unique.

EasyForth Snake Demo

In order to make this easier, I extracted the code for the Easy Forth playground and made it into its own page. Instead of a small box that displayed the graphics defined by the Forth code, I expanded it into a large playground with the code on one side and the graphics on the other.

During our final session, I told them to modify the snake game. They quickly discovered they could change the rules and colors with small changes to the code. They didn't have the skills to refactor anything major, but they had developed enough familiarity with Forth that they weren't scared away from exploring and tinkering.

Then I had them make their own art. I gave them an example of using the built-in graphics to draw things, and even showed an example of creating a word to make drawing shapes like lines easier. Every student decided to make their own art. For the most part, they stuck to drawing pixel by pixel.

Once they were done drawing, the class was over and the course was complete. I told them I would keep my copy of the learning environment online for a while. They were welcome to keep experimenting and learning on their own if they wished.

Reflections on Forth

In retrospect, Forth was an interesting language to teach kids, but I'm not sure if it was the best option. While the language lacked difficult syntax, it also required thinking about parts of software systems even a lot of programmers keep tucked safely abstracted below the level they normally work. The stack is a fundamental data structure, but it's not necessarily something students need front-and-center during their early education.

Even with Forth's drawbacks, the fact that the resulting code was a mere series of words was powerful. A concatenative programming language with more higher-level constructs may be helpful for teaching. Possibly something like Factor, or even a radically different approach!

I would have probably chosen a medium that provides even more clear and immediate visual feedback and even less emphasis on the underlying structures. Something like Scratch, which teaches control flow, variables, functions, and the like, but without some of the lower level details. And it's easy to make sprites move!

Overall, I don't believe the programming language matters all too much. For the most part, Forth is as perfectly capable as any other language. This short course showed that students can learn it effectively. Some students may pick up some paradigms better than others, but there is likely no way to perfectly micro-optimize the learning process. Provide kids with an environment that allows them to see the output of their work quickly and repeatably, and I believe most will thrive. Opportunity for self-direction is key.

Regardless, this class gave both me and my students a unique experience. If any of them choose to pursue programming going forward, they have already taken a low-level introduction. One that required an intimate understanding of a fundamental data structure in computer science. It provided me with an opportunity to learn and grow as a teacher—to iterate in teaching the same way I asked them to iterate in learning.

The Importance of Teaching

One last addendum to wrap this up. As programming becomes driven by stochastic automation, it's even more vital to teach people how to program themselves. For those who already know how to program, our skills will atrophy if we begin to rely on LLMs. But for those who haven't ever learned skills like programming, using LLMs may cause them to surrender the skill entirely.

Additionally, many people who do want to learn new skills are turning to LLMs, increasingly replacing learning from potentially reputable sources with learning from a technology which has been shown to be inaccurate, sycophantic, and in some cases seriously worsen mental illness. All of these are more dangerous in kids, who are just learning how to interact with the world for themselves.

Because of this, it's essential to provide everyone, especially kids, a human-centered environment to learn vital skills like programming. More people from various backgrounds should be willing to devote our time and energy to share the knowledge we have, as well as explaining how to safely obtain further knowledge.

Even if you're not a teacher, learn to teach. Embrace these opportunities. Create spaces where knowledge flows freely between people. Skip the stochastic parrot.

sentences.zh: 我还知道，如果我布置作业，考虑到他们在我的班级之外生活，他们不太可能完成太多作业。

blocks.html_en: The tangible learning outcome was for students to create their own art in the Forth environment. This could be anything from a simple drawing to an animation to a game. I wanted them to have something they could see and keep with them after the course had ended. It can be discouraging to learn a lot of technical details on a topic and feel like you had little to show for it.

sentences.en: The tangible learning outcome was for students to create their own art in the Forth environment.
sentences.zh: 切实的学习成果是让学生在第四环境中创造自己的艺术。

sentences.en: This could be anything from a simple drawing to an animation to a game.
sentences.zh: 这可以是任何东西，从简单的绘图到动画再到游戏。

sentences.en: I wanted them to have something they could see and keep with them after the course had ended.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们在课程结束后能看到并随身携带一些东西。

sentences.en: It can be discouraging to learn a lot of technical details on a topic and feel like you had little to show for it.
sentences.zh: 学习某个主题的大量技术细节并且感觉自己没什么可展示的，这可能会令人沮丧。

blocks.html_en: It was important that the students could run the code the wrote on their own computers. It was doubly important that they didn't have to download or install anything for it to work, since students could be using a variety of operating systems—some of which may not be capable of installing third party software.

sentences.en: It was important that the students could run the code the wrote on their own computers.
sentences.zh: 重要的是学生可以在自己的计算机上运行编写的代码。

sentences.en: It was doubly important that they didn't have to download or install anything for it to work, since students could be using a variety of operating systems—some of which may not be capable of installing third party software.
sentences.zh: 双重重要的是，他们无需下载或安装任何东西即可运行，因为学生可能使用各种操作系统 - 其中一些可能无法安装第三方软件。

blocks.html_en: My first choice for our learning environment involved writing my own Forth from scratch in Rust and embedding it in our course website with WASM. Unfortunately, ironing out the bugs in my implementation took longer than I intended. So I switched gears and chose to use Nick Morgan's Easy Forth as both our cirriculum and Forth interpreter.

sentences.en: My first choice for our learning environment involved writing my own Forth from scratch in Rust and embedding it in our course website with WASM.
sentences.zh: 我对学习环境的第一选择是用 Rust 从头开始​​编写自己的 Forth，并使用 WASM 将其嵌入到我们的课程网站中。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, ironing out the bugs in my implementation took longer than I intended.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，解决我的实现中的错误花费的时间比我预期的要长。

sentences.en: So I switched gears and chose to use Nick Morgan's Easy Forth as both our cirriculum and Forth interpreter.
sentences.zh: 所以我改变了方向，选择使用 Nick Morgan 的 Easy Forth 作为我们的课程和 Forth 翻译。

blocks.html_en: For each lesson, I created slides and a lesson plan which I uploaded to an online portal which the students could access. This included a copy of Easy Forth.

sentences.en: For each lesson, I created slides and a lesson plan which I uploaded to an online portal which the students could access.
sentences.zh: 对于每节课，我都创建了幻灯片和课程计划，并将其上传到学生可以访问的在线门户。

sentences.en: This included a copy of Easy Forth.
sentences.zh: 其中包括一份 Easy Forth。

blocks.html_en: Introducing Computing

sentences.en: Introducing Computing
sentences.zh: 计算简介

blocks.html_en: It was then time to start going over the actual lessons with the students. I plugged my laptop into the large TV to display my slides and began the introductory lecture.

sentences.en: It was then time to start going over the actual lessons with the students.
sentences.zh: 然后是时候开始与学生一起温习实际课程了。

sentences.en: I plugged my laptop into the large TV to display my slides and began the introductory lecture.
sentences.zh: 我将笔记本电脑插入大电视以显示幻灯片并开始介绍性讲座。

blocks.html_en: We started by going over the history of computing and what a computer is. One of my favorite parts was showing them various devices and asking them if they were computers. They were initially perplexed when I showed them an abacus and told them it was a computer. Our working definition was, "Anything that calculates numbers." They soon realized that almost anything could be a computer, including themselves!

sentences.en: We started by going over the history of computing and what a computer is.
sentences.zh: 我们首先回顾了计算的历史以及计算机是什么。

sentences.en: One of my favorite parts was showing them various devices and asking them if they were computers.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的部分之一是向他们展示各种设备并询问他们是否是计算机。

sentences.en: They were initially perplexed when I showed them an abacus and told them it was a computer.
sentences.zh: 当我向他们展示算盘并告诉他们这是一台计算机时，他们最初感到困惑。

sentences.en: Our working definition was, "Anything that calculates numbers."
sentences.zh: 我们的工作定义是“任何计算数字的东西”。

sentences.en: They soon realized that almost anything could be a computer, including themselves!
sentences.zh: 他们很快意识到几乎任何东西都可以是计算机，包括他们自己！

blocks.html_en: This is a computer!

sentences.en: This is a computer!
sentences.zh: 这是一台电脑！

blocks.html_en: After breaking their idea of what a computer could be and setting their expectations, I began to teach them about Forth in particular. I explained the places it's used and its embedded applications.

sentences.en: After breaking their idea of what a computer could be and setting their expectations, I began to teach them about Forth in particular.
sentences.zh: 在打破了他们对计算机的看法并设定了他们的期望之后，我开始专门教他们有关 Forth 的知识。

sentences.en: I explained the places it's used and its embedded applications.
sentences.zh: 我解释了它的使用场所及其嵌入式应用程序。

blocks.html_en: Once the fundamentals were down, the next step was to move to our cirriculum and dive into Forth. However, Easy Forth assumes its readers know at least one programming language and know about stack-based data structures. That was far from the case here. It was my job to bridge that gap.

sentences.en: Once the fundamentals were down, the next step was to move to our cirriculum and dive into Forth.
sentences.zh: 一旦基础知识扎实，下一步就是转向我们的课程并深入研究 Forth。

sentences.en: However, Easy Forth assumes its readers know at least one programming language and know about stack-based data structures.
sentences.zh: 然而，Easy Forth 假设读者至少了解一种编程语言并且了解基于堆栈的数据结构。

sentences.en: That was far from the case here.
sentences.zh: 这里的情况远非如此。

sentences.en: It was my job to bridge that gap.
sentences.zh: 我的工作就是弥合这一差距。

blocks.html_en: What is a Stack?

sentences.en: What is a Stack?
sentences.zh: 什么是堆栈？

blocks.html_en: Before even touching our computers, we had to begin to visualize the fundamental data structure underlying Forth: the data stack.

sentences.en: Before even touching our computers, we had to begin to visualize the fundamental data structure underlying Forth: the data stack.
sentences.zh: 在接触计算机之前，我们必须开始可视化 Forth 底层的基本数据结构：数据堆栈。

blocks.html_en: Anyone with a rudimentary computer science education will understand what a data stack is and its operations, but normally that's not the first thing introduced to new learners.

sentences.en: Anyone with a rudimentary computer science education will understand what a data stack is and its operations, but normally that's not the first thing introduced to new learners.
sentences.zh: 任何受过基础计算机科学教育的人都会了解什么是数据堆栈及其操作，但通常这不是向新学习者介绍的第一件事。

blocks.html_en: So I used plates.

sentences.en: So I used plates.
sentences.zh: 所以我用了盘子。

blocks.html_en: In Forth, when you type numbers surrounded by whitespace, they are added to the stack. For example, this adds 1, 2, and 3 to the data stack:

sentences.en: In Forth, when you type numbers surrounded by whitespace, they are added to the stack.
sentences.zh: 在 Forth 中，当您键入由空格包围的数字时，它们将被添加到堆栈中。

sentences.en: For example, this adds 1, 2, and 3 to the data stack:
sentences.zh: 例如，将 1、2 和 3 添加到数据堆栈中：

blocks.html_en: If you were to print these numbers, such as with . . ., the outputted text would be 3 2 1. This is because a stack is a Last-In First-Out data structure. You can either "push" an item onto a stack (put it on top), or pop an item off a stack (pull it off the top). For the most part, more complex operations are implemented in terms of those.

sentences.en: If you were to print these numbers, such as with . . ., the outputted text would be 3 2 1.
sentences.zh: 如果您要打印这些数字，例如使用 . 。 .，输出的文本将为 3 2 1。

sentences.en: This is because a stack is a Last-In First-Out data structure.
sentences.zh: 这是因为堆栈是后进先出的数据结构。

sentences.en: You can either "push" an item onto a stack (put it on top), or pop an item off a stack (pull it off the top).
sentences.zh: 您可以将项目“推入”堆栈（将其放在顶部），也可以将项目从堆栈中弹出（将其从顶部拉出）。

sentences.en: For the most part, more complex operations are implemented in terms of those.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，更复杂的操作是根据这些来实现的。

blocks.html_en: To represent this, I gave every student a pile of paper plates. I then instructed them to execute certain Forth operations with those plates. When instructed to push a number onto the stack, they wrote the number on a plate and put it on top of their stacks. When instructed to add the top two numbers on the stack, they removed them, added them, and pushed a new number onto the stack.

sentences.en: To represent this, I gave every student a pile of paper plates.
sentences.zh: 为了代表这一点，我给了每个学生一堆纸盘。

sentences.en: I then instructed them to execute certain Forth operations with those plates.
sentences.zh: 然后我指示他们用这些盘子执行某些 Forth 操作。

sentences.en: When instructed to push a number onto the stack, they wrote the number on a plate and put it on top of their stacks.
sentences.zh: 当指示将一个数字推入堆栈时，他们将数字写在盘子上并将其放在堆栈的顶部。

sentences.en: When instructed to add the top two numbers on the stack, they removed them, added them, and pushed a new number onto the stack.
sentences.zh: 当指示将堆栈顶部的两个数字相加时，他们将它们删除，添加它们，然后将一个新数字压入堆栈。

blocks.html_en: Push 7 and 6 to the top of the stack, then add the top two items of the stack and push the result on top. The result will be 13.

sentences.en: Push 7 and 6 to the top of the stack, then add the top two items of the stack and push the result on top.
sentences.zh: 将 7 和 6 压入栈顶，然后将栈顶的两项相加，并将结果压入栈顶。

sentences.en: The result will be 13.
sentences.zh: 结果将是 13。

blocks.html_en: Push 2 and 3 to the top of the stack, then multiply the top two items of the stack, pushing the result on top. The result will be six.

sentences.en: Push 2 and 3 to the top of the stack, then multiply the top two items of the stack, pushing the result on top.
sentences.zh: 将 2 和 3 推入栈顶，然后将栈顶的两项相乘，将结果推入栈顶。

sentences.en: The result will be six.
sentences.zh: 结果将是六个。

blocks.html_en: I instructed them to perform many operations until they were familiar with what they were doing. They were acting as Forth interpreters. The computer is just doing this work automatically. This gave them a more intimate understanding of what their system was doing.

sentences.en: I instructed them to perform many operations until they were familiar with what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 我指导他们执行许多操作，直到他们熟悉自己在做什么。

sentences.en: They were acting as Forth interpreters.
sentences.zh: 他们担任第四口译员。

sentences.en: The computer is just doing this work automatically.
sentences.zh: 计算机只是自动完成这项工作。

sentences.en: This gave them a more intimate understanding of what their system was doing.
sentences.zh: 这让他们更深入地了解他们的系统正在做什么。

blocks.html_en: Only then did their machines do the work for them.

sentences.en: Only then did their machines do the work for them.
sentences.zh: 只有这样，他们的机器才能为他们完成工作。

blocks.html_en: Moving Forth

sentences.en: Moving Forth
sentences.zh: 前进

blocks.html_en: With the stack fresh in their memories, we marched forward, following Easy Forth lessons week by week, keeping pace to complete them by the end of the course. It proceeded without issue. I explained the concepts, they did the exercises, and I answered questions as they came up.

sentences.en: With the stack fresh in their memories, we marched forward, following Easy Forth lessons week by week, keeping pace to complete them by the end of the course.
sentences.zh: 随着他们对堆栈的记忆犹新，我们继续前进，每周学习 Easy Forth 课程，并保持进度以在课程结束时完成它们。

sentences.en: It proceeded without issue.
sentences.zh: 一切顺利进行。

sentences.en: I explained the concepts, they did the exercises, and I answered questions as they came up.
sentences.zh: 我解释了概念，他们做了练习，我回答了他们提出的问题。

blocks.html_en: Since we only had twelve hours together, the final project had to be small, but it also had to demonstrate the knowledge built up throughout the course. I determined that we would use the graphics framework created in Easy Forth to make our own art of any variety. It could be a picture, an animation, or a game. I didn't really believe they had time to make a game, but they were encouraged to tinker with the built-in snake game in order to make something unique.

sentences.en: Since we only had twelve hours together, the final project had to be small, but it also had to demonstrate the knowledge built up throughout the course.
sentences.zh: 由于我们只有十二个小时在一起，所以最终的项目必须很小，但它也必须展示整个课程中积累的知识。

sentences.en: I determined that we would use the graphics framework created in Easy Forth to make our own art of any variety.
sentences.zh: 我决定使用 Easy Forth 中创建的图形框架来制作我们自己的各种艺术作品。

sentences.en: It could be a picture, an animation, or a game.
sentences.zh: 它可以是图片、动画或游戏。

sentences.en: I didn't really believe they had time to make a game, but they were encouraged to tinker with the built-in snake game in order to make something unique.
sentences.zh: 我真的不相信他们有时间制作游戏，但他们被鼓励修补内置的贪吃蛇游戏，以创造出独特的东西。

blocks.html_en: EasyForth Snake Demo

sentences.en: EasyForth Snake Demo
sentences.zh: EasyForth 蛇演示

blocks.html_en: In order to make this easier, I extracted the code for the Easy Forth playground and made it into its own page. Instead of a small box that displayed the graphics defined by the Forth code, I expanded it into a large playground with the code on one side and the graphics on the other.

sentences.en: In order to make this easier, I extracted the code for the Easy Forth playground and made it into its own page.
sentences.zh: 为了使这更容易，我提取了 Easy Forth Playground 的代码并将其放入自己的页面中。

sentences.en: Instead of a small box that displayed the graphics defined by the Forth code, I expanded it into a large playground with the code on one side and the graphics on the other.
sentences.zh: 我没有将其扩展为一个显示 Forth 代码定义的图形的小盒子，而是将其扩展为一个大型游乐场，一侧是代码，另一侧是图形。

blocks.html_en: During our final session, I told them to modify the snake game. They quickly discovered they could change the rules and colors with small changes to the code. They didn't have the skills to refactor anything major, but they had developed enough familiarity with Forth that they weren't scared away from exploring and tinkering.

sentences.en: During our final session, I told them to modify the snake game.
sentences.zh: 在我们的最后一次会议中，我告诉他们修改蛇游戏。

sentences.en: They quickly discovered they could change the rules and colors with small changes to the code.
sentences.zh: 他们很快发现只需对代码进行少量更改即可更改规则和颜色。

sentences.en: They didn't have the skills to refactor anything major, but they had developed enough familiarity with Forth that they weren't scared away from exploring and tinkering.
sentences.zh: 他们没有能力重构任何重要的东西，但他们对 Forth 已经足够熟悉，所以他们不会害怕探索和修补。

blocks.html_en: Then I had them make their own art. I gave them an example of using the built-in graphics to draw things, and even showed an example of creating a word to make drawing shapes like lines easier. Every student decided to make their own art. For the most part, they stuck to drawing pixel by pixel.

sentences.en: Then I had them make their own art.
sentences.zh: 然后我让他们创作自己的艺术品。

sentences.en: I gave them an example of using the built-in graphics to draw things, and even showed an example of creating a word to make drawing shapes like lines easier.
sentences.zh: 我给他们提供了一个使用内置图形来绘制东西的示例，甚至还展示了一个创建单词以使绘制线条等形状更容易的示例。

sentences.en: Every student decided to make their own art.
sentences.zh: 每个学生都决定创作自己的艺术。

sentences.en: For the most part, they stuck to drawing pixel by pixel.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，他们坚持逐像素绘制。

blocks.html_en: Once they were done drawing, the class was over and the course was complete. I told them I would keep my copy of the learning environment online for a while. They were welcome to keep experimenting and learning on their own if they wished.

sentences.en: Once they were done drawing, the class was over and the course was complete.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们画完，课程就结束了，课程也结束了。

sentences.en: I told them I would keep my copy of the learning environment online for a while.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他们我会将学习环境的副本保留在网上一段时间。

sentences.en: They were welcome to keep experimenting and learning on their own if they wished.

blocks.html_en: Reflections on Forth

sentences.en: Reflections on Forth
sentences.zh: 对福斯的思考

blocks.html_en: In retrospect, Forth was an interesting language to teach kids, but I'm not sure if it was the best option. While the language lacked difficult syntax, it also required thinking about parts of software systems even a lot of programmers keep tucked safely abstracted below the level they normally work. The stack is a fundamental data structure, but it's not necessarily something students need front-and-center during their early education.

sentences.en: In retrospect, Forth was an interesting language to teach kids, but I'm not sure if it was the best option.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，Forth 对于教孩子来说是一门有趣的语言，但我不确定这是否是最好的选择。

sentences.en: While the language lacked difficult syntax, it also required thinking about parts of software systems even a lot of programmers keep tucked safely abstracted below the level they normally work.
sentences.zh: 虽然该语言缺乏困难的语法，但它也需要考虑软件系统的某些部分，即使许多程序员仍然将其安全地抽象到他们通常工作的水平以下。

sentences.en: The stack is a fundamental data structure, but it's not necessarily something students need front-and-center during their early education.
sentences.zh: 堆栈是一种基本的数据结构，但它不一定是学生在早期教育中需要重点关注的东西。

blocks.html_en: Even with Forth's drawbacks, the fact that the resulting code was a mere series of words was powerful. A concatenative programming language with more higher-level constructs may be helpful for teaching. Possibly something like Factor, or even a radically different approach!

sentences.en: Even with Forth's drawbacks, the fact that the resulting code was a mere series of words was powerful.
sentences.zh: 尽管 Forth 存在缺点，但生成的代码仅仅是一系列单词这一事实仍然很强大。

sentences.en: A concatenative programming language with more higher-level constructs may be helpful for teaching.
sentences.zh: 具有更高级结构的串联编程语言可能对教学有所帮助。

sentences.en: Possibly something like Factor, or even a radically different approach!
sentences.zh: 可能类似于 Factor，甚至是完全不同的方法！

blocks.html_en: I would have probably chosen a medium that provides even more clear and immediate visual feedback and even less emphasis on the underlying structures. Something like Scratch, which teaches control flow, variables, functions, and the like, but without some of the lower level details. And it's easy to make sprites move!

sentences.en: I would have probably chosen a medium that provides even more clear and immediate visual feedback and even less emphasis on the underlying structures.
sentences.zh: 我可能会选择一种能够提供更清晰、更即时的视觉反馈、更少强调底层结构的媒介。

sentences.en: Something like Scratch, which teaches control flow, variables, functions, and the like, but without some of the lower level details.
sentences.zh: 像 Scratch 这样的东西，它教授控制流、变量、函数等，但没有一些较低级别的细节。

sentences.en: And it's easy to make sprites move!
sentences.zh: 而且很容易让精灵移动！

blocks.html_en: Overall, I don't believe the programming language matters all too much. For the most part, Forth is as perfectly capable as any other language. This short course showed that students can learn it effectively. Some students may pick up some paradigms better than others, but there is likely no way to perfectly micro-optimize the learning process. Provide kids with an environment that allows them to see the output of their work quickly and repeatably, and I believe most will thrive. Opportunity for self-direction is key.

sentences.en: Overall, I don't believe the programming language matters all too much.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我不认为编程语言太重要。

sentences.en: For the most part, Forth is as perfectly capable as any other language.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，Forth 与任何其他语言一样完美。

sentences.en: This short course showed that students can learn it effectively.
sentences.zh: 这个短期课程表明学生可以有效地学习它。

sentences.en: Some students may pick up some paradigms better than others, but there is likely no way to perfectly micro-optimize the learning process.
sentences.zh: 有些学生可能比其他学生更好地掌握某些范式，但可能没有办法完美地微观优化学习过程。

sentences.en: Provide kids with an environment that allows them to see the output of their work quickly and repeatably, and I believe most will thrive.
sentences.zh: 为孩子们提供一个让他们能够快速、可重复地看到自己的工作成果的环境，我相信大多数人都会茁壮成长。

sentences.en: Opportunity for self-direction is key.
sentences.zh: 自我指导的机会是关键。

blocks.html_en: Regardless, this class gave both me and my students a unique experience. If any of them choose to pursue programming going forward, they have already taken a low-level introduction. One that required an intimate understanding of a fundamental data structure in computer science. It provided me with an opportunity to learn and grow as a teacher—to iterate in teaching the same way I asked them to iterate in learning.

sentences.en: Regardless, this class gave both me and my students a unique experience.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这门课给我和我的学生带来了独特的体验。

sentences.en: If any of them choose to pursue programming going forward, they have already taken a low-level introduction.
sentences.zh: 如果他们中的任何人选择继续从事编程，那么他们已经进行了低级介绍。

sentences.en: One that required an intimate understanding of a fundamental data structure in computer science.
sentences.zh: 需要深入了解计算机科学中的基本数据结构。

sentences.en: It provided me with an opportunity to learn and grow as a teacher—to iterate in teaching the same way I asked them to iterate in learning.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供了作为一名教师学习和成长的机会——以我要求他们迭代学习的方式迭代教学。

blocks.html_en: The Importance of Teaching

sentences.en: The Importance of Teaching
sentences.zh: 教学的重要性

blocks.html_en: One last addendum to wrap this up. As programming becomes driven by stochastic automation, it's even more vital to teach people how to program themselves. content_html_zh:
2026-04-14 · 11 分钟 · #computing

Forth 很少用于教孩子们编程。 Python 等脚本语言和 Scratch 等可视化环境是更受欢迎的选择。 但当我有机会向中学生和高中生介绍编程时，我选择了 1970 年的面向堆栈的连接语言。

我对这个机会感到欣喜若狂。 我热衷于让人们对他们每天携带的设备中蕴藏的潜力有更多的控制权。 当人们更多地了解计算机，特别是如何制作自己的软件时，整个世界就会变得开放。 这让我有机会为那些可能永远不会发现这个世界的人撬开通往这个世界的大门。

虽然我之前曾教过个人编程，但这是我第一次在课堂环境中进行教学。 我从对教学几乎一无所知到设计自己的课程，包括课程计划、课程和数字学习环境。

为什么是福斯？

我可以选择教授任何编程语言。 我本可以选择 Python 或 Scratch，但我想探索一条不太常见的路径，也许会发现一些被忽视的宝石。

由于我教学的时间有限，而且我想教授更多基本概念，因此我想避免教授语法。 虽然 Python 作为伪代码对于理解代码是什么的人来说是有意义的，但对于新学习者来说它仍然几乎难以理解，这是我在前几年一对一教授编程时发现的。

我决定要么教 Forth，要么教 Haskell。 Forth 很有吸引力，因为它是一种连接语言。 您编写指令，它就会按顺序执行所有操作。 只要你了解什么是栈，你就可以编写 Forth 程序。

Haskell 很有吸引力，因为它与学生已经接受的如何思考数学变量和函数的方式很好地结合在一起。 我见过太多新程序员感到困惑，在编程中，变量是可以包含任何值的框，而不是他们在数学课上学到的代数定义。

我最终选择 Forth 有两个原因。 首先，更容易融入我为学生准备的定制学习环境。 其次，我认为在课堂最终演示中，过程式编程比函数式编程更容易概念化。

另一个好处是，使用像 Forth 这样的半晦涩的语言可以确保即使是以前学过编程的学生也能从经验中学到一些东西，而不会疏远新学习者。

设计课程

在设计课程时，我知道时间会很紧迫。 我参加了 12 次课程，每周一次，每次一小时。 我还知道，如果我布置作业，考虑到他们在我的班级之外生活，他们不太可能完成太多作业。

切实的学习成果是让学生在第四环境中创造自己的艺术。 这可以是任何东西，从简单的绘图到动画再到游戏。 我希望他们在课程结束后能看到并随身携带一些东西。 学习某个主题的大量技术细节并且感觉自己没什么可展示的，这可能会令人沮丧。

重要的是学生可以在自己的计算机上运行编写的代码。 双重重要的是，他们无需下载或安装任何东西即可运行，因为学生可能使用各种操作系统 - 其中一些可能无法安装第三方软件。

我对学习环境的第一选择是用 Rust 从头开始​​编写自己的 Forth，并使用 WASM 将其嵌入到我们的课程网站中。 不幸的是，解决我的实现中的错误花费的时间比我预期的要长。 所以我改变了方向，选择使用 Nick Morgan 的 Easy Forth 作为我们的课程和 Forth 翻译。

对于每节课，我都创建了幻灯片和课程计划，并将其上传到学生可以访问的在线门户。 其中包括一份 Easy Forth。

计算简介

然后是时候开始与学生一起温习实际课程了。 我将笔记本电脑插入大电视以显示幻灯片并开始介绍性讲座。

我们首先回顾了计算的历史以及计算机是什么。 我最喜欢的部分之一是向他们展示各种设备并询问他们是否是计算机。 当我向他们展示算盘并告诉他们这是一台计算机时，他们最初感到困惑。 我们的工作定义是“任何计算数字的东西”。 他们很快意识到几乎任何东西都可以是计算机，包括他们自己！

这是一台电脑！

在打破了他们对计算机的看法并设定了他们的期望之后，我开始专门教他们有关 Forth 的知识。 我解释了它的使用场所及其嵌入式应用程序。

一旦基础知识扎实，下一步就是转向我们的课程并深入研究 Forth。 然而，Easy Forth 假设读者至少了解一种编程语言并且了解基于堆栈的数据结构。 这里的情况远非如此。 我的工作就是弥合这一差距。

什么是堆栈？

在接触计算机之前，我们必须开始可视化 Forth 底层的基本数据结构：数据堆栈。

任何受过基础计算机科学教育的人都会了解什么是数据堆栈及其操作，但通常这不是向新学习者介绍的第一件事。

所以我用了盘子。

在 Forth 中，当您键入由空格包围的数字时，它们将被添加到堆栈中。 例如，将 1、2 和 3 添加到数据堆栈中：

1 2 3

如果您要打印这些数字，例如使用 . 。 .，输出的文本将为 3 2 1。 这是因为堆栈是后进先出的数据结构。 您可以将项目“推入”堆栈（将其放在顶部），也可以将项目从堆栈中弹出（将其从顶部拉出）。 在大多数情况下，更复杂的操作是根据这些来实现的。

为了代表这一点，我给了每个学生一堆纸盘。 然后我指示他们用这些盘子执行某些 Forth 操作。 当指示将一个数字推入堆栈时，他们将数字写在盘子上并将其放在堆栈的顶部。 当指示将堆栈顶部的两个数字相加时，他们将它们删除，添加它们，然后将一个新数字压入堆栈。

将 7 和 6 压入栈顶，然后将栈顶的两项相加，并将结果压入栈顶。 结果将是 13。

8 6 +

将 2 和 3 推入栈顶，然后将栈顶的两项相乘，将结果推入栈顶。 结果将是六个。

2 3 *

我指导他们执行许多操作，直到他们熟悉自己在做什么。 他们担任第四口译员。 计算机只是自动完成这项工作。 这让他们更深入地了解他们的系统正在做什么。

只有这样，他们的机器才能为他们完成工作。

前进

随着他们对堆栈的记忆犹新，我们继续前进，每周学习 Easy Forth 课程，并保持进度以在课程结束时完成它们。 一切顺利进行。 我解释了概念，他们做了练习，我回答了他们提出的问题。

由于我们只有十二个小时在一起，所以最终的项目必须很小，但它也必须展示整个课程中积累的知识。 我决定使用 Easy Forth 中创建的图形框架来制作我们自己的各种艺术作品。 它可以是图片、动画或游戏。 我真的不相信他们有时间制作游戏，但他们被鼓励修补内置的贪吃蛇游戏，以创造出独特的东西。

EasyForth 蛇演示

为了使这更容易，我提取了 Easy Forth Playground 的代码并将其放入自己的页面中。 我没有将其扩展为一个显示 Forth 代码定义的图形的小盒子，而是将其扩展为一个大型游乐场，一侧是代码，另一侧是图形。

在我们的最后一次会议中，我告诉他们修改蛇游戏。 他们很快发现只需对代码进行少量更改即可更改规则和颜色。 他们没有能力重构任何重要的东西，但他们对 Forth 已经足够熟悉，所以他们不会害怕探索和修补。

然后我让他们创作自己的艺术品。 我给他们提供了一个使用内置图形来绘制东西的示例，甚至还展示了一个创建单词以使绘制线条等形状更容易的示例。 每个学生都决定创作自己的艺术。 在大多数情况下，他们坚持逐像素绘制。

一旦他们画完，课程就结束了，课程也结束了。 我告诉他们我会将学习环境的副本保留在网上一段时间。 如果他们愿意，我们欢迎他们继续尝试和学习。

对福斯的思考

回想起来，Forth 对于教孩子来说是一门有趣的语言，但我不确定这是否是最好的选择。 虽然该语言缺乏困难的语法，但它也需要考虑软件系统的某些部分，即使许多程序员仍然将其安全地抽象到他们通常工作的水平以下。 堆栈是一种基本的数据结构，但它不一定是学生在早期教育中需要重点关注的东西。

尽管 Forth 存在缺点，但生成的代码仅仅是一系列单词这一事实仍然很强大。 具有更高级结构的串联编程语言可能对教学有所帮助。 可能类似于 Factor，甚至是完全不同的方法！

我可能会选择一种能够提供更清晰、更即时的视觉反馈、更少强调底层结构的媒介。 像 Scratch 这样的东西，它教授控制流、变量、函数等，但没有一些较低级别的细节。 而且很容易让精灵移动！

总的来说，我不认为编程语言太重要。 在大多数情况下，Forth 与任何其他语言一样完美。 这个短期课程表明学生可以有效地学习它。 有些学生可能比其他学生更好地掌握某些范式，但可能没有办法完美地微观优化学习过程。 为孩子们提供一个让他们能够快速、可重复地看到自己的工作成果的环境，我相信大多数人都会茁壮成长。 自我指导的机会是关键。

无论如何，这门课给我和我的学生带来了独特的体验。 如果他们中的任何人选择继续从事编程，那么他们已经进行了低级介绍。 需要深入了解计算机科学中的基本数据结构。 它为我提供了作为一名教师学习和成长的机会——以我要求他们迭代学习的方式迭代教学。

教学的重要性

最后一个附录来总结这一点。 随着编程变得由随机自动化驱动，教人们如何自己编程就变得更加重要。 对于那些已经知道如何编程的人来说，如果我们开始依赖法学硕士，我们的技能就会萎缩。 但对于那些从未学过编程等技能的人来说，使用法学硕士可能会导致他们完全放弃这项技能。

此外，许多确实想学习新技能的人正在转向法学硕士，越来越多地用一种已被证明不准确、阿谀奉承、在某些情况下严重恶化精神疾病的技术来取代从可能有信誉的来源学习。 所有这些对于刚刚学习如何自己与世界互动的孩子来说更加危险。

因此，必须为每个人（尤其是孩子）提供一个以人为本的环境来学习编程等重要技能。 更多来自不同背景的人应该愿意投入时间和精力来分享我们所拥有的知识，并解释如何安全地获取更多知识。

即使你不是老师，也要学会教书。 拥抱这些机会。 创造知识在人与人之间自由流动的空间。 跳过随机鹦鹉。
